Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch a6620c30adcdf0d9529ee66977694bfa2a06d5c3 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-raise-gate-grammar, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-raise-gate-grammar <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-raise-gate-grammar; that second push is the return signal. Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Role: root-cause seat. Read dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md and dev/governance/rules/defect-root-cause.md from main, and follow them exactly. Topic: r10-rca-raise-gate-grammar. You run beside the R10-POLICY-LINT-FAMILY fix (topic r10-policy-lint-family, carry "Triage P-F recurrence 2" in the roster group at origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster) and never inside it: do not edit that fix, do not push to its refs.
Defect: the budget-raise-gate refused PR #2647 twice, and #2633 once before it. The first #2647 refusal was a missing verdict word (the score line had no IMPROVES|NULL|WORSENS); the second was the verdict word IMPROVES placed outside the `## Raise justification` section. Both times pr-contract, body_patch.sh and the fix reviewer passed the body, and the refusal appeared only at train pre-flight, one parked run costing about 50 min of CI. The gate is tools/.../budget_raise_gate.py `justification()` (find it with git grep; JUSTIFICATION_PAID, JUSTIFICATION_SCORE).
It owes, all four: (1) a named cause, reproduced at the SHA where each instance was found, not accepted from this brief (check which side moved with git log); (2) one process state (a)-(d) with the quoted process line or check shown present or absent, obeyed or not (the interim hand rule "run the section-scoped regex, require count 1" existed for instance 2; the countermeasure carry existed and was unbuilt); (3) the class search (what else a late gate checks that an earlier check cannot) and a cost test with measured numbers (instances, minutes per parked run, mandated raise PRs to come); (4) a countermeasure or a recorded refusal. Note the audit-class barrier is one recurrence away (three instances): say what the barrier owes. Never assert a number you did not measure.
Return: write the Root cause section as a PR body file and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-raise-gate-grammar <body.md>` (pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-raise-gate-grammar; that is the return signal). Push code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-raise-gate-grammar only if your countermeasure is a check, test, lane or hook, and then demonstrate it failing on the defect and passing once fixed, plus a null control; policy files are drafted and proposed, not landed. Rules: PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; spare the GitHub API (bulk-list once, prefer git over the API, stop on a 403); no Claude footers.
